scope: Bounded publication-safety review of code/protocol/reports/README, necessary execution CLI/launch/fetch/manifest text, and STK .sc/.sc3 text. No scientific result recalculation; no cloud/SSH credential stores read; no original source modifications.
excluded_from_claim: external SSH key or credential-store contents
recommendations: Sanitize concrete SSH endpoint, key-file name and Windows user-profile references only in export copies of operational helper scripts/records. Do not publish keys or authentication stores.
Preserve scientific source/data/checkpoint/result bytes; record original_sha256 and export_sha256 plus reason when operational text is changed.
Document CLI root-path overrides and licensed Windows STK environment; retain historical scientific project paths as provenance.
